ns2:course.label: Supervised Teaching
ns2:course.description: Practical teaching experience under the supervision of a faculty member; weekly conference devoted to evaluation and planning. Teaching areas include major and non-major university courses and classes for community adults and children. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours with approval.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours with approval.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Dance or Dance major(s).
